attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) as an HTTP load-balancing entry point on its management address 10.100.3.10:80 using the os-haproxy plugin, round-robin balancing across HTTP backends on node2 (10.100.3.11:8080) and node3 (10.100.3.12:8080), each running a Python http.server that identifies itself. Verified node4 receives responses from both backends through this single entry point. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time native reboot protocol on all four nodes (node2, node3, node4, node1) with captured pre/post boot-identity proof and post-restart service recovery, finishing with a final check from node4 confirming continued balanced responses through node1's port 80 after every restart.
